mapper.select: SELECT m.material_id, m.course_id, m.uploader_id, m.file_name, m.file_path, m.file_type, m.file_size, m.description, m.upload_time, m.download_count, c.course_name, u.username AS uploader_name FROM materials m JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id JOIN users u ON m.uploader_id = u.user_id ORDER BY c.course_name ASC, m.upload_time DESC

SELECT m.material_id, m.course_id, m.uploader_id, m.file_name, m.file_path, m.file_type, m.file_size, m.description, m.upload_time, m.download_count, c.course_name, u.username AS uploader_name FROM materials m JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id JOIN users u ON m.uploader_id = u.user_id WHERE m.material_id = #{materialId}

SELECT m.material_id, m.course_id, m.uploader_id, m.file_name, m.file_path, m.file_type, m.file_size, m.description, m.upload_time, m.download_count, c.course_name, u.username AS uploader_name FROM materials m JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id JOIN users u ON m.uploader_id = u.user_id WHERE m.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY m.upload_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO materials (course_id, uploader_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, description, upload_time) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{uploaderId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{description}, #{uploadTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE materials SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
